changes.title: Creature momentum
items: Animals chasing you have momentum: they can't turn on the spot at a run, react a moment late, and only aim ahead of you with attacks they warn you of, so a sidestep or a blink makes them overshoot

changes.title: Crown lights
items: The great oak's crown has half as many strings of lights, and each one hangs its own way: swags, long drapes, tails hanging down, spirals round the limbs, garlands part way round
The treehouse's warm light now spills up into the crown above its rooms
The party areas' string lights hang at different heights and sags, some with tails; a pause-page slider gives them more

changes.title: Rune glow
items: With ?sigils=new, rune stones' runes glow much brighter in their rank colour, readable through the trees (a Rune stone glow slider on the pause page)
